name: Boku no Saimin Sekai
source:
I woke up, went to work, came home and slept. Every day was the same.
But one day my fatally boring life changed.
It started with a spam mail promising a method of mesmerism.
Pffssh, whatever, I thought... and gave it a try.

The love-filled hypnotic adventure sim of a school teacher and his bratty female students!
He's spent his career looking at cuties he's not allowed to touch... until now!

我起床，去上班，回家睡觉。每天都是一样的。

它始于一封承诺催眠方法的垃圾邮件。
Pffssh，无论如何，我想……并尝试了一下。

学校老师和他的调皮女学生的充满爱的催眠冒险模拟游戏！
他的整个职业生涯都在观察那些他不被允许碰触的美人……直到现在！
